title: Development and validation of a microenvironment-related prognostic model for hepatocellular carcinoma patients based on histone deacetylase family.
summary: The full text confirms a machine-learning-derived HDAC1/HDAC11 prognostic model followed by qRT-PCR, HPLC, flow cytometry, Western blot and immunohistochemistry experiments linking the candidates to fatty-acid metabolism and macrophage polarization.
ai_technology: The full text confirms a machine-learning-derived HDAC1/HDAC11 prognostic model followed by qRT-PCR, HPLC, flow cytometry, Western blot and immunohistochemistry experiments linking the candidates to fatty-acid metabolism and macrophage polarization.

evidence.tested: The learned prognostic model identified HDAC1/HDAC11; follow-up assays found gene-expression and macrophage-polarization effects after HDAC inhibition.
evidence.unknown: Cohort survival association is retrospective; separate in-vitro assays support the proposed mechanism but do not show clinical treatment benefit.
